title: Claude Code Source Leak Incident
snippet: A debug source map accidentally included in the Claude Code npm package exposed 390,000 lines of TypeScript. Root cause: Bun runtime bug serving source maps in production.

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
snippet: Open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged pull requests using AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex) in isolated K8s pods.

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
snippet: Microsoft-led tool for managing agent configuration (plugins, skills, rules) across Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor with lockfiles and audits.

title: Show HN: Urlx – an agent-made Rust replacement for curl/libcurl
snippet: An agent-made Rust replacement for curl that passes 1,300 of 1,300 curl tests, passing 100% pass rate. Proves agents can iterate autonomously on specs.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
snippet: Unified control layer to secure and govern AI agents. Mentions first-class OpenClaw support and cognitive drift monitoring.

title: Show HN: Sweet! CLI – Cheaper alternative to Claude Code or Codex CLI
snippet: Features 'autopilot' for monitoring live deployed applications and detecting outages. Multiple agents deployed to production for triage.

title: Show HN: Sally CLI – AI code reviewer with build gates
snippet: AI code reviewer ready for CI/CD with --fail-under flags for build gates. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.

title: Ask HN: What is your dev set up like?
snippet: Discussion on Claude Code and Cursor. Users expressing need for CLI-based API key management (Stripe Projects) to speed up agent deployments.
